item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate whether declared source dependencies have changed.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\n\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a deterministic representation that preserves JSON value types.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        value,\\n        sort_keys=True,\\n        separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"),\\n        ensure_ascii=False,\\n        allow_nan=False,\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return review status and changed declared paths for request.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    declared = request.get(\\\"declared\\\", [])\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", []))\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n\\n    changed = []\\n    for path in set(declared) - ignored:\\n        saved_state = saved.get(path, _MISSING)\\n        current_state = current.get(path, _MISSING)\\n        if _canonical_json(saved_state) != _canonical_json(current_state):\\n            changed.append(path)\\n\\n    changed.sort()\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}"}
